replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Hey there,

I'm the mod that banned you, here is the evidence of you hacking: https://youtu.be/l0NhAzlSGFo

Unfortunately, it has only been 2 months since you were banned, and the guidelines state that you may only appeal and be successfully unbanned after 6-8 months. I advise you wait out your punishment and come back then.

1. Anyone is free to record Avicus videos here.
2. We currently don't have a youtuber rank, but if you mean media you have to apply for it. You must record and stream tournament matches. 

If you have any other questions feel free to ask me,
Spoookeh
